abbott_smith_html:
εἰ,
conjunctive particle, used in conditions and in indirect questions.
__I. Conditional, if;
__1. with indic, expressing a general assumption;
__(a) pres.: before indic, pres., Mat.11:14, Rom.8:25, al.; before imperat., Mrk.4:23 9:22, Jhn.15:18, 1Co.7:9, al.; before fut. indic., Luk.16:31, Rom.8:11, al.; before pf. or aor., with negation in apodosis, Mat.12:26, Rom.4:14, al.; similarly, before impf., Luk.17:6, Jhn.8:39; before quæst., Mat.6:23, Jhn.5:47 7:23 8:46, 1Pe.2:20;
__(b) fut.: Mat.26:33, 1Pe.2:20;
__(with) pf.: Jhn.11:12, Rom.6:5, al.;
__(d) aor.: Luk.16:11 19:8, Jhn.13:32, 18:23, Rev.20:15, al.
__2. Where the assumption is certain = ἐπεί: Mat.12:28, Jhn.7:4, Rom.5:17, al.
__3. Of an unfulfilled condition, with indic, impf., aor. or plpf., before ἄν, with imp. or aor. (see: ἄν, I, i).
__4. C. indic., after verbs denoting wonder, etc., sometimes, but not always, coupled with an element of doubt: Mrk.15:44, 1Jn.3:13, al.
__5. C. indic., as in LXX (Num.14:3o, 1Ki.14:45, al. = Heb. אִם), in oaths, with the formula of imprecation understood in a suppressed apodosis (WM, 627; Burton, §272): Mrk.8:12, Heb.3:11" (LXX) 4:3 (LXX).
__6. Rarely (cl.) with optative, to express a merely possible condition: Act.24:19 27:39, 1Co.14:10 15:37, I Pe3:14, 17.
__II. Interrogative, if, whether.
__1. As in cl., in indir. questions after verbs of seeing, asking, knowing, saying, etc.: with indic. pres., Mat.26:63, Mrk.15:36, Act.19:2, 2Co.13:5, al.; fut., Mrk.3:2, Act.8:22, al.; aor., Mrk.15:44, 1Co.1:16, al.; with subjc. aor. (M, Pr., 194), Php.3:12.
__2. As in LXX (= Heb. אִם and interrog. הֲ, Gen.17:17, al.; see WM, 639f.; Viteau, i, 22), in direct questions: Mrk.8:23 (Tr., WH, txt.), Luk.13:23, 22:49, Act.19:2, al.
__III. With other particles.
__1. εἰ ἄρα, εἴγε, εἰ δὲ μήγε, see: ἄρα, γε.
__2. εἰ δὲ καί, but if also: Luk.11:18; but even if, 1Co.4:7, 2Co.4:3 11:16.
__3. εἰ δὲ μή, but if not, but if otherwise: Mrk.2:21, 22 Jhn.14:2, Rev.2:5, al.
__4. εἰ καί, if even, if also, although: Mrk.14:29, Luk.11:8, 1Co.7:21, 2Co.4:16, Php.2:17, al.
__5. καὶ εἰ, even if, see: καί
__6. εἰ μή, if not, unless, except, but only: Mat.24:22, Mrk.2:26 6:5, Jhn.9:33, 1Co.7:17 (only), Gal.1:19 (cf. ἐὰν μή, 2:16; see Hort., Ja., xvi); ἐκτὸς εἰ μή, pleonastic (Bl., §65, 6), 1Co.14:5 15:2, 1Ti.5:19.
__7. εἰ μήν = cl. ἦ μήν (M, Pr., 46), in oaths, surely (Eze.33:27, al.): Heb.6:14.
__8. εἴ πως, if haply: Act.27:12, Rom.1:10.
__9. εἴτε . . . εἴτε, whether . . . or; Rom.12:6-8, 1Co.3:22 13:8, al.
(AS)

occurrences.bsb: The tempter came to Him and said, “If You are the Son of God, tell these stones to become bread.”
occurrences.kjv: And when the tempter came to him, he said, If thou be the Son of God, command that these stones be made bread.

occurrences.bsb: “If You are the Son of God,” he said, “throw Yourself down. For it is written: ‘He will command His angels concerning You, and they will lift You up in their hands, so that You will not strike Your foot against a stone.’”
occurrences.kjv: And saith unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down: for it is written, He shall give his angels charge concerning thee: and in their hands they shall bear thee up, lest at any time thou dash thy foot against a stone.

occurrences.bsb: You are the salt of the earth. But if the salt loses its savor, how can it be made salty again? It is no longer good for anything, except to be thrown out and trampled by men.
occurrences.kjv: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.

occurrences.bsb: If your right eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.
occurrences.kjv: And if thy right eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

occurrences.bsb: And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to lose one part of your body than for your whole body to depart into hell.
occurrences.kjv: And if thy right hand offend thee, cut it off, and cast it from thee: for it is profitable for thee that one of thy members should perish, and not that thy whole body should be cast into hell.

occurrences.bsb: “Be careful not to perform your righteous acts before men to be seen by them. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven.
occurrences.kjv: Take heed that ye do not your alms before men, to be seen of them: otherwise ye have no reward of your Father which is in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: But if your eyes are bad, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light within you is darkness, how great is that darkness!
occurrences.kjv: But if thine eye be evil, thy whole body shall be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in thee be darkness, how great is that darkness!

occurrences.bsb: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, will He not much more clothe you, O you of little faith?
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore, if God so clothe the grass of the field, which to day is, and to morrow is cast into the oven, shall he not much more clothe you, O ye of little faith?

occurrences.bsb: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give good things to those who ask Him!
occurrences.kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?

occurrences.bsb: So the demons begged Jesus, “If You drive us out, send us into the herd of pigs.”
occurrences.kjv: So the devils besought him, saying, If thou cast us out, suffer us to go away into the herd of swine.

occurrences.bsb: Neither do men pour new wine into old wineskins. If they do, the skins will burst, the wine will spill, and the wineskins will be ruined. Instead, they pour new wine into new wineskins, and both are preserved.”
occurrences.kjv: Neither do men put new wine into old bottles: else the bottles break, and the wine runneth out, and the bottles perish: but they put new wine into new bottles, and both are preserved.

occurrences.bsb: It is enough for a disciple to be like his teacher, and a servant like his master. If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, how much more the members of his household!
occurrences.kjv: It is enough for the disciple that he be as his master, and the servant as his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebub, how much more shall they call them of his household?

occurrences.bsb: And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.
occurrences.kjv: And if ye will receive it, this is Elias, which was for to come.

occurrences.bsb: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
occurrences.kjv: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works, which were done in you, had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

occurrences.bsb: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted up to heaven? No, you will be brought down to Hades! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Sodom, it would have remained to this day.
occurrences.kjv: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted unto heaven, shalt be brought down to hell: for if the mighty works, which have been done in thee, had been done in Sodom, it would have remained until this day.

occurrences.bsb: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.
occurrences.kjv: All things are delivered unto me of my Father: and no man knoweth the Son, but the Father; neither knoweth any man the Father, save the Son, and he to whomsoever the Son will reveal him.

occurrences.bsb: He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread, which was not lawful for them to eat, but only for the priests.
occurrences.kjv: How he entered into the house of God, and did eat the shewbread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for them which were with him, but only for the priests?

occurrences.bsb: If only you had known the meaning of ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.
occurrences.kjv: But if ye had known what this meaneth, I will have mercy, and not sacrifice, ye would not have condemned the guiltless.

occurrences.bsb: and a man with a withered hand was there. In order to accuse Jesus, they asked Him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
occurrences.kjv: And, behold, there was a man which had his hand withered. And they asked him, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath days? that they might accuse him.

occurrences.bsb: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, “Only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, does this man drive out demons.”
occurrences.kjv: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This fellow doth not cast out devils, but by Beelzebub the prince of the devils.

occurrences.bsb: If Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then can his kingdom stand?
occurrences.kjv: And if Satan cast out Satan, he is divided against himself; how shall then his kingdom stand?

occurrences.bsb: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
occurrences.kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your children cast them out? therefore they shall be your judges.

occurrences.bsb: But if I drive out demons by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
occurrences.kjv: But if I cast out devils by the Spirit of God, then the kingdom of God is come unto you.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
occurrences.kjv: But he answered and said unto them, An evil and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given to it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas:

occurrences.bsb: And they took offense at Him. But Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”
occurrences.kjv: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.

occurrences.bsb: “We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered.
occurrences.kjv: And they say unto him, We have here but five loaves, and two fishes.

occurrences.bsb: “Lord, if it is You,” Peter replied, “command me to come to You on the water.”
occurrences.kjv: And Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it be thou, bid me come unto thee on the water.

occurrences.bsb: He answered, “I was sent only to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”
occurrences.kjv: But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

occurrences.bsb: A wicked and adulterous generation demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.” Then He left them and went away.
occurrences.kjv: A wicked and adulterous generation seeketh after a sign; and there shall no sign be given unto it, but the sign of the prophet Jonas. And he left them, and departed.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus told His disciples, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
occurrences.kjv: Then said Jesus unto his disciples, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

occurrences.bsb: Peter said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If You wish, I will put up three shelters—one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”
occurrences.kjv: Then answered Peter, and said unto Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if thou wilt, let us make here three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias.

occurrences.bsb: And when they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus.
occurrences.kjv: And when they had lifted up their eyes, they saw no man, save Jesus only.

occurrences.bsb: If your hand or your foot causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life crippled or lame than to have two hands and two feet and be thrown into the eternal fire.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore if thy hand or thy foot offend thee, cut them off, and cast them from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life halt or maimed, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into everlasting fire.

occurrences.bsb: And if your eye causes you to sin, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.
occurrences.kjv: And if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out, and cast it from thee: it is better for thee to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into hell fire.

occurrences.bsb: But when that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred denarii. He grabbed him and began to choke him, saying, ‘Pay back what you owe me!’
occurrences.kjv: But the same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest.

occurrences.bsb: Then some Pharisees came and tested Him by asking, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”
occurrences.kjv: The Pharisees also came unto him, tempting him, and saying unto him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife for every cause?

occurrences.bsb: His disciples said to Him, “If this is the case between a man and his wife, it is better not to marry.”
occurrences.kjv: His disciples say unto him, If the case of the man be so with his wife, it is not good to marry.

occurrences.bsb: “Why do you ask Me about what is good?” Jesus replied. “There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, keep the commandments.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus told him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow Me.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou wilt be perfect, go and sell that thou hast, and give to the poor, and thou shalt have treasure in heaven: and come and follow me.

occurrences.bsb: Seeing a fig tree by the road, He went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. “May you never bear fruit again!” He said. And immediately the tree withered.
occurrences.kjv: And when he saw a fig tree in the way, he came to it, and found nothing thereon, but leaves only, and said unto it, Let no fruit grow on thee henceforward for ever. And presently the fig tree withered away.

occurrences.bsb: So if David calls Him ‘Lord,’ how can He be David’s son?”
occurrences.kjv: If David then call him Lord, how is he his son?

occurrences.bsb: And you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partners with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’
occurrences.kjv: And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.

occurrences.bsb: If those days had not been cut short, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, those days will be cut short.
occurrences.kjv: And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect’s sake those days shall be shortened.

occurrences.bsb: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders to deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
occurrences.kjv: For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall shew great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect.

occurrences.bsb: No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
occurrences.kjv: But of that day and hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

occurrences.bsb: But understand this: If the homeowner had known in which watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.
occurrences.kjv: But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up.

occurrences.bsb: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed. It would be better for him if he had not been born.”
occurrences.kjv: The Son of man goeth as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born.

occurrences.bsb: Peter said to Him, “Even if all fall away on account of You, I never will.”
occurrences.kjv: Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of thee, yet will I never be offended.

occurrences.bsb: Going a little farther, He fell facedown and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass from Me. Yet not as I will, but as You will.”
occurrences.kjv: And he went a little further, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as thou wilt.

occurrences.bsb: A second time He went away and prayed, “My Father, if this cup cannot pass unless I drink it, may Your will be done.”
occurrences.kjv: He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, thy will be done.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus remained silent. Then the high priest said to Him, “I charge You under oath by the living God: Tell us if You are the Christ, the Son of God.”
occurrences.kjv: But Jesus held his peace. And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure thee by the living God, that thou tell us whether thou be the Christ, the Son of God.

occurrences.bsb: and saying, “You who are going to destroy the temple and rebuild it in three days, save Yourself! If You are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”
occurrences.kjv: And saying, Thou that destroyest the temple, and buildest it in three days, save thyself. If thou be the Son of God, come down from the cross.

occurrences.bsb: He trusts in God. Let God deliver Him now if He wants Him. For He said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”
occurrences.kjv: He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God.

occurrences.bsb: But the others said, “Leave Him alone. Let us see if Elijah comes to save Him.”
occurrences.kjv: The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elias will come to save him.

occurrences.bsb: “Why does this man speak like this? He is blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
occurrences.kjv: Why doth this man thus speak blasphemies? who can forgive sins but God only?

occurrences.bsb: No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. If he does, the new piece will pull away from the old, and a worse tear will result.
occurrences.kjv: No man also seweth a piece of new cloth on an old garment: else the new piece that filled it up taketh away from the old, and the rent is made worse.

occurrences.bsb: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. Instead, new wine is poured into new wineskins.”
occurrences.kjv: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles: else the new wine doth burst the bottles, and the wine is spilled, and the bottles will be marred: but new wine must be put into new bottles.

occurrences.bsb: During the high priesthood of Abiathar, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which was lawful only for the priests. And he gave some to his companions as well.”
occurrences.kjv: How he went into the house of God in the days of Abiathar the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?

occurrences.bsb: In order to accuse Jesus, they were watching to see if He would heal on the Sabbath.
occurrences.kjv: And they watched him, whether he would heal him on the sabbath day; that they might accuse him.

occurrences.bsb: And if Satan is divided and rises against himself, he cannot stand; his end has come.
occurrences.kjv: And if Satan rise up against himself, and be divided, he cannot stand, but hath an end.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear.”
occurrences.kjv: If any man have ears to hear, let him hear.

occurrences.bsb: And He did not allow anyone to accompany Him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.
occurrences.kjv: And he suffered no man to follow him, save Peter, and James, and John the brother of James.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus said to them, “Only in his hometown, among his relatives, and in his own household is a prophet without honor.”
occurrences.kjv: But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, but in his own country, and among his own kin, and in his own house.

occurrences.bsb: So He could not perform any miracles there, except to lay His hands on a few of the sick and heal them.
occurrences.kjv: And he could there do no mighty work, save that he laid his hands upon a few sick folk, and healed them.

occurrences.bsb: He instructed them to take nothing but a staff for the journey—no bread, no bag, no money in their belts—
occurrences.kjv: And commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, save a staff only; no scrip, no bread, no money in their purse:

occurrences.bsb: Jesus sighed deeply in His spirit and said, “Why does this generation demand a sign? Truly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”
occurrences.kjv: And he sighed deeply in his spirit, and saith, Why doth this generation seek after a sign? verily I say unto you, There shall no sign be given unto this generation.

occurrences.bsb: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, except for one loaf they had with them in the boat.
occurrences.kjv: Now the disciples had forgotten to take bread, neither had they in the ship with them more than one loaf.

occurrences.bsb: So He took the blind man by the hand and led him out of the village. Then He spit on the man’s eyes and placed His hands on him. “Can you see anything?” He asked.
occurrences.kjv: And he took the blind man by the hand, and led him out of the town; and when he had spit on his eyes, and put his hands upon him, he asked him if he saw ought.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus called the crowd to Him along with His disciples, and He told them, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.
occurrences.kjv: And when he had called the people unto him with his disciples also, he said unto them, Whosoever will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

occurrences.bsb: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus admonished them not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
occurrences.kjv: And as they came down from the mountain, he charged them that they should tell no man what things they had seen, till the Son of man were risen from the dead.

occurrences.bsb: “It often throws him into the fire or into the water, trying to kill him. But if You can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”
occurrences.kjv: And ofttimes it hath cast him into the fire, and into the waters, to destroy him: but if thou canst do any thing, have compassion on us, and help us.

occurrences.bsb: “If You can?” echoed Jesus. “All things are possible to him who believes!”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus said unto him, If thou canst believe, all things are possible to him that believeth.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “This kind cannot come out, except by prayer.”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto them, This kind can come forth by nothing, but by prayer and fasting.

occurrences.bsb: Sitting down, Jesus called the Twelve and said, “If anyone wants to be first, he must be the last of all and the servant of all.”
occurrences.kjv: And he sat down, and called the twelve, and saith unto them, If any man desire to be first, the same shall be last of all, and servant of all.

occurrences.bsb: But if anyone causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a large millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea.
occurrences.kjv: And whosoever shall offend one of these little ones that believe in me, it is better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he were cast into the sea.

occurrences.bsb: Some Pharisees came to test Him. “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?” they inquired.
occurrences.kjv: And the Pharisees came to him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to put away his wife? tempting him.

occurrences.bsb: “Why do you call Me good?” Jesus replied. “No one is good except God alone.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God.

occurrences.bsb: Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, He went to see if there was any fruit on it. But when He reached it, He found nothing on it except leaves, since it was not the season for figs.
occurrences.kjv: And seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came, if haply he might find any thing thereon: and when he came to it, he found nothing but leaves; for the time of figs was not yet.

occurrences.bsb: And when you stand to pray, if you hold anything against another, forgive it, so that your Father in heaven will forgive your trespasses as well.”
occurrences.kjv: And when ye stand praying, forgive, if ye have ought against any: that your Father also which is in heaven may forgive you your trespasses.

occurrences.bsb: If the Lord had not cut short those days, nobody would be saved. But for the sake of the elect, whom He has chosen, He has cut them short.
occurrences.kjv: And except that the Lord had shortened those days, no flesh should be saved: but for the elect’s sake, whom he hath chosen, he hath shortened the days.

occurrences.bsb: For false Christs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders to deceive even the elect, if that were possible.
occurrences.kjv: For false Christs and false prophets shall rise, and shall shew signs and wonders, to seduce, if it were possible, even the elect.

occurrences.bsb: No one knows about that day or hour, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
occurrences.kjv: But of that day and that hour knoweth no man, no, not the angels which are in heaven, neither the Son, but the Father.

occurrences.bsb: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about Him, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed! It would be better for him if he had not been born.”
occurrences.kjv: The Son of man indeed goeth, as it is written of him: but woe to that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! good were it for that man if he had never been born.

occurrences.bsb: Peter declared, “Even if all fall away, I never will.”
occurrences.kjv: But Peter said unto him, Although all shall be offended, yet will not I.

occurrences.bsb: Going a little farther, He fell to the ground and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour would pass from Him.
occurrences.kjv: And he went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass from him.

occurrences.bsb: And someone ran and filled a sponge with sour wine. He put it on a reed and held it up for Jesus to drink, saying, “Leave Him alone. Let us see if Elijah comes to take Him down.”
occurrences.kjv: And one ran and filled a spunge full of vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let alone; let us see whether Elias will come to take him down.

occurrences.bsb: Pilate was surprised to hear that Jesus was already dead, so he summoned the centurion to ask if this was so.
occurrences.kjv: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.

occurrences.bsb: The devil said to Him, “If You are the Son of God, tell this stone to become bread.”
occurrences.kjv: And the devil said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread.

occurrences.bsb: Then the devil led Him to Jerusalem and set Him on the pinnacle of the temple. “If You are the Son of God,” he said, “throw Yourself down from here.
occurrences.kjv: And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If thou be the Son of God, cast thyself down from hence:

occurrences.bsb: Yet Elijah was not sent to any of them, but to the widow of Zarephath in Sidon.
occurrences.kjv: But unto none of them was Elias sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow.

occurrences.bsb: And there were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet. Yet not one of them was cleansed—only Naaman the Syrian.”
occurrences.kjv: And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian.

occurrences.bsb: But the scribes and Pharisees began thinking to themselves, “Who is this man who speaks blasphemy? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
occurrences.kjv: And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaketh blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?

occurrences.bsb: He also told them a parable: “No one tears a piece of cloth from a new garment and sews it on an old one. If he does, he will tear the new garment as well, and the patch from the new will not match the old.
occurrences.kjv: And he spake also a parable unto them; No man putteth a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new maketh a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agreeth not with the old.

occurrences.bsb: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. If he does, the new wine will burst the skins, the wine will spill, and the wineskins will be ruined.
occurrences.kjv: And no man putteth new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish.

occurrences.bsb: He entered the house of God, took the consecrated bread and gave it to his companions, and ate what is lawful only for the priests to eat.”
occurrences.kjv: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?

occurrences.bsb: Looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, the scribes and Pharisees were watching Him closely to see if He would heal on the Sabbath.
occurrences.kjv: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus said to them, “I ask you, which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to destroy it?”
occurrences.kjv: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?

occurrences.bsb: If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? Even sinners love those who love them.
occurrences.kjv: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.

occurrences.bsb: When the Pharisee who had invited Jesus saw this, he said to himself, “If this man were a prophet, He would know who this is and what kind of woman is touching Him—for she is a sinner!”
occurrences.kjv: Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spake within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that toucheth him: for she is a sinner.

occurrences.bsb: When He entered the house, He did not allow anyone to go in with Him except Peter, John, James, and the child’s father and mother.
occurrences.kjv: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.

occurrences.bsb: But Jesus told them, “You give them something to eat.” “We have only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered, “unless we go and buy food for all these people.”
occurrences.kjv: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.

occurrences.bsb: Then Jesus said to all of them, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow Me.
occurrences.kjv: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.

occurrences.bsb: If a man of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; if not, it will return to you.
occurrences.kjv: And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again.

occurrences.bsb: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.
occurrences.kjv: Woe unto thee, Chorazin! woe unto thee, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

occurrences.bsb: All things have been entrusted to Me by My Father. No one knows who the Son is except the Father, and no one knows who the Father is except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal Him.”
occurrences.kjv: All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.

occurrences.bsb: I tell you, even though he will not get up to provide for him because of his friendship, yet because of the man’s persistence, he will get up and give him as much as he needs.
occurrences.kjv: I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needeth.

occurrences.bsb: So if you who are evil know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father in heaven give the Holy Spirit to those who ask Him!”
occurrences.kjv: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to them that ask him?

occurrences.bsb: If Satan is divided against himself, how can his kingdom stand? After all, you say that I drive out demons by Beelzebul.
occurrences.kjv: If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub.

occurrences.bsb: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
occurrences.kjv: And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges.

occurrences.bsb: But if I drive out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
occurrences.kjv: But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God is come upon you.

occurrences.bsb: As the crowds were increasing, Jesus said, “This is a wicked generation. It demands a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.
occurrences.kjv: And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.

occurrences.bsb: So if your whole body is full of light, with no part of it in darkness, you will be radiant, as though a lamp were shining on you.”
occurrences.kjv: If thy whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle doth give thee light.

occurrences.bsb: So if you cannot do such a small thing, why do you worry about the rest?
occurrences.kjv: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?

occurrences.bsb: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field, which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace, how much more will He clothe you, O you of little faith!
occurrences.kjv: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?

occurrences.bsb: But understand this: If the homeowner had known at what hour the thief was coming, he would not have let his house be broken into.
occurrences.kjv: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.

occurrences.bsb: I have come to ignite a fire on the earth, and how I wish it were already kindled!
occurrences.kjv: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?

occurrences.bsb: If it bears fruit next year, fine. But if not, you can cut it down.’”
occurrences.kjv: And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that thou shalt cut it down.

occurrences.bsb: “Lord,” someone asked Him, “will only a few people be saved?” Jesus answered,
occurrences.kjv: Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them,

occurrences.bsb: “If anyone comes to Me and does not hate his father and mother and wife and children and brothers and sisters—yes, even his own life—he cannot be My disciple.
occurrences.kjv: If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple.

occurrences.bsb: Which of you, wishing to build a tower, does not first sit down and count the cost to see if he has the resources to complete it?
occurrences.kjv: For which of you, intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it?

occurrences.bsb: Or what king on his way to war with another king will not first sit down and consider whether he can engage with ten thousand men the one coming against him with twenty thousand?
occurrences.kjv: Or what king, going to make war against another king, sitteth not down first, and consulteth whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that cometh against him with twenty thousand?

occurrences.bsb: And if he is unable, he will send a delegation while the other king is still far off, to ask for terms of peace.
occurrences.kjv: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sendeth an ambassage, and desireth conditions of peace.

occurrences.bsb: So if you have not been faithful with worldly wealth, who will entrust you with true riches?
occurrences.kjv: If therefore ye have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

occurrences.bsb: And if you have not been faithful with the belongings of another, who will give you belongings of your own?
occurrences.kjv: And if ye have not been faithful in that which is another man’s, who shall give you that which is your own?

occurrences.bsb: Then Abraham said to him, ‘If they do not listen to Moses and the Prophets, they will not be persuaded even if someone rises from the dead.’”
occurrences.kjv: And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.

occurrences.bsb: It would be better for him to have a millstone hung around his neck and to be thrown into the sea than to cause one of these little ones to stumble.
occurrences.kjv: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones.

occurrences.bsb: And the Lord answered, “If you have faith the size of a mustard seed, you can say to this mulberry tree, ‘Be uprooted and planted in the sea,’ and it will obey you.
occurrences.kjv: And the Lord said, If ye had faith as a grain of mustard seed, ye might say unto this sycamine tree, Be thou plucked up by the root, and be thou planted in the sea; and it should obey you.

occurrences.bsb: Was no one found except this foreigner to return and give glory to God?”
occurrences.kjv: There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger.

occurrences.bsb: For a while he refused, but later he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect men,
occurrences.kjv: And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man;

occurrences.bsb: “Why do you call Me good?” Jesus replied. “No one is good except God alone.
occurrences.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me good? none is good, save one, that is, God.

occurrences.bsb: But Zacchaeus stood up and said to the Lord, “Look, Lord, half of my possessions I give to the poor, and if I have cheated anyone, I will repay it fourfold.”
occurrences.kjv: And Zaccheus stood, and said unto the Lord; Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold.

occurrences.bsb: and said, “If only you had known on this day what would bring you peace! But now it is hidden from your eyes.
occurrences.kjv: Saying, If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes.

occurrences.bsb: “Father, if You are willing, take this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.

occurrences.bsb: Those around Jesus saw what was about to happen and said, “Lord, should we strike with our swords?”
occurrences.kjv: When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we smite with the sword?

occurrences.bsb: “If You are the Christ, tell us.” Jesus answered, “If I tell you, you will not believe.
occurrences.kjv: Art thou the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, ye will not believe:

occurrences.bsb: When Pilate heard this, he asked if the man was a Galilean.
occurrences.kjv: When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilean.

occurrences.bsb: For if men do these things while the tree is green, what will happen when it is dry?”
occurrences.kjv: For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry?

occurrences.bsb: The people stood watching, and the rulers sneered at Him, saying, “He saved others; let Him save Himself if He is the Christ of God, the Chosen One.”
occurrences.kjv: And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God.

occurrences.bsb: “If You are the King of the Jews,” they said, “save Yourself!”
occurrences.kjv: And saying, If thou be the king of the Jews, save thyself.

occurrences.bsb: asked him, “Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?”
occurrences.kjv: And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptizest thou then, if thou be not that Christ, nor Elias, neither that prophet?

occurrences.bsb: If I have told you about earthly things and you do not believe, how will you believe if I tell you about heavenly things?
occurrences.kjv: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?

occurrences.bsb: No one has ascended into heaven except the One who descended from heaven—the Son of Man.
occurrences.kjv: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “If you knew the gift of God and who is asking you for a drink, you would have asked Him, and He would have given you living water.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

occurrences.bsb: If you had believed Moses, you would believe Me, because he wrote about Me.
occurrences.kjv: For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.

occurrences.bsb: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how will you believe what I say?”
occurrences.kjv: But if ye believe not his writings, how shall ye believe my words?

occurrences.bsb: The next day, the crowd that had remained on the other side of the sea realized that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not boarded it with His disciples, but they had gone away alone.
occurrences.kjv: The day following, when the people which stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was none other boat there, save that one whereinto his disciples were entered, and that Jesus went not with his disciples into the boat, but that his disciples were gone away alone;

occurrences.bsb: not that anyone has seen the Father except the One who is from God; only He has seen the Father.
occurrences.kjv: Not that any man hath seen the Father, save he which is of God, he hath seen the Father.

occurrences.bsb: For no one who wants to be known publicly acts in secret. Since You are doing these things, show Yourself to the world.”
occurrences.kjv: For there is no man that doeth any thing in secret, and he himself seeketh to be known openly. If thou do these things, shew thyself to the world.

occurrences.bsb: If a boy can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses will not be broken, why are you angry with Me for making the whole man well on the Sabbath?
occurrences.kjv: If a man on the sabbath day receive circumcision, that the law of Moses should not be broken; are ye angry at me, because I have made a man every whit whole on the sabbath day?

occurrences.bsb: “Where is Your Father?” they asked Him. “You do not know Me or My Father,” Jesus answered. “If you knew Me, you would know My Father as well.”
occurrences.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is thy Father? Jesus answered, Ye neither know me, nor my Father: if ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also.

occurrences.bsb: “Abraham is our father,” they replied. “If you were children of Abraham,” said Jesus, “you would do the works of Abraham.
occurrences.kjv: They answered and said unto him, Abraham is our father. Jesus saith unto them, If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love Me, for I have come here from God. I have not come on My own, but He sent Me.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If God were your Father, ye would love me: for I proceeded forth and came from God; neither came I of myself, but he sent me.

occurrences.bsb: Which of you can prove Me guilty of sin? If I speak the truth, why do you not believe Me?
occurrences.kjv: Which of you convinceth me of sin? And if I say the truth, why do ye not believe me?

occurrences.bsb: He answered, “Whether He is a sinner I do not know. There is one thing I do know: I was blind, but now I see!”
occurrences.kjv: He answered and said, Whether he be a sinner or no, I know not: one thing I know, that, whereas I was blind, now I see.

occurrences.bsb: If this man were not from God, He could do no such thing.”
occurrences.kjv: If this man were not of God, he could do nothing.

occurrences.bsb: “If you were blind,” Jesus replied, “you would not be guilty of sin. But since you claim you can see, your guilt remains.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus said unto them, If ye were blind, ye should have no sin: but now ye say, We see; therefore your sin remaineth.

occurrences.bsb: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy. I have come that they may have life, and have it in all its fullness.
occurrences.kjv: The thief cometh not, but for to steal, and to kill, and to destroy: I am come that they might have life, and that they might have it more abundantly.

occurrences.bsb: So the Jews gathered around Him and demanded, “How long will You keep us in suspense? If You are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
occurrences.kjv: Then came the Jews round about him, and said unto him, How long dost thou make us to doubt? If thou be the Christ, tell us plainly.

occurrences.bsb: If he called them gods to whom the word of God came—and the Scripture cannot be broken—
occurrences.kjv: If he called them gods, unto whom the word of God came, and the scripture cannot be broken;

occurrences.bsb: If I am not doing the works of My Father, then do not believe Me.
occurrences.kjv: If I do not the works of my Father, believe me not.

occurrences.bsb: But if I am doing them, even though you do not believe Me, believe the works themselves, so that you may know and understand that the Father is in Me, and I am in the Father.”
occurrences.kjv: But if I do, though ye believe not me, believe the works: that ye may know, and believe, that the Father is in me, and I in him.

occurrences.bsb: His disciples replied, “Lord, if he is sleeping, he will get better.”
occurrences.kjv: Then said his disciples, Lord, if he sleep, he shall do well.

occurrences.bsb: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.
occurrences.kjv: Then said Martha unto Jesus, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

occurrences.bsb: When Mary came to Jesus and saw Him, she fell at His feet and said, “Lord, if You had been here, my brother would not have died.”
occurrences.kjv: Then when Mary was come where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying unto him, Lord, if thou hadst been here, my brother had not died.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus told him, “Whoever has already bathed needs only to wash his feet, and he will be completely clean. And you are clean, though not all of you.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith to him, He that is washed needeth not save to wash his feet, but is clean every whit: and ye are clean, but not all.

occurrences.bsb: So if I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one another’s feet.
occurrences.kjv: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another’s feet.

occurrences.bsb: If you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.
occurrences.kjv: If ye know these things, happy are ye if ye do them.

occurrences.bsb: If God is glorified in Him, God will also glorify the Son in Himself—and will glorify Him at once.
occurrences.kjv: If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall straightway glorify him.

occurrences.bsb: In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?
occurrences.kjv: In my Father’s house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

occurrences.bsb: If you had known Me, you would know My Father as well. From now on you do know Him and have seen Him.”
occurrences.kjv: If ye had known me, ye should have known my Father also: and from henceforth ye know him, and have seen him.

occurrences.bsb: Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me—or at least believe on account of the works themselves.
occurrences.kjv: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

occurrences.bsb: You heard Me say, ‘I am going away, and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved Me, you would rejoice that I am going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I.
occurrences.kjv: Ye have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If ye loved me, ye would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I.

occurrences.bsb: If the world hates you, understand that it hated Me first.
occurrences.kjv: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before it hated you.

occurrences.bsb: If you were of the world, it would love you as its own. Instead, the world hates you, because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world.
occurrences.kjv: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.

occurrences.bsb: Remember the word that I spoke to you: ‘No servant is greater than his master.’ If they persecuted Me, they will persecute you as well; if they kept My word, they will keep yours as well.
occurrences.kjv: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.

occurrences.bsb: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin. Now, however, they have no excuse for their sin.
occurrences.kjv: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.

occurrences.bsb: If I had not done among them the works that no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin; but now they have seen and hated both Me and My Father.
occurrences.kjv: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.

occurrences.bsb: While I was with them, I protected and preserved them by Your name, the name You gave Me. Not one of them has been lost, except the son of destruction, so that the Scripture would be fulfilled.
occurrences.kjv: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name: those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.

occurrences.bsb: “I told you that I am He,” Jesus replied. “So if you are looking for Me, let these men go.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore ye seek me, let these go their way:

occurrences.bsb: Jesus replied, “If I said something wrong, testify as to what was wrong. But if I spoke correctly, why did you strike Me?”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smitest thou me?

occurrences.bsb: “If He were not a criminal,” they replied, “we would not have handed Him over to you.”
occurrences.kjv: They answered and said unto him, If he were not a malefactor, we would not have delivered him up unto thee.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “My kingdom is not of this world; if it were, My servants would fight to prevent My arrest by the Jews. But now My kingdom is not of this realm.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from hence.

occurrences.bsb: Jesus answered, “You would have no authority over Me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed Me over to you is guilty of greater sin.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus answered, Thou couldest have no power at all against me, except it were given thee from above: therefore he that delivered me unto thee hath the greater sin.

occurrences.bsb: At this, they shouted, “Away with Him! Away with Him! Crucify Him!” “Shall I crucify your King?” Pilate asked. “We have no king but Caesar,” replied the chief priests.
occurrences.kjv: But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate saith unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Cesar.

occurrences.bsb: “Woman, why are you weeping?” Jesus asked. “Whom are you seeking?” Thinking He was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried Him off, tell me where you have put Him, and I will get Him.”
occurrences.kjv: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, why weepest thou? whom seekest thou? She, supposing him to be the gardener, saith unto him, Sir, if thou have borne him hence, tell me where thou hast laid him, and I will take him away.

occurrences.bsb: So when they came together, they asked Him, “Lord, will You at this time restore the kingdom to Israel?”
occurrences.kjv: When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?

occurrences.bsb: If we are being examined today about a kind service to a man who was lame, to determine how he was healed,
occurrences.kjv: If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole;

occurrences.bsb: But Peter and John replied, “Judge for yourselves whether it is right in God’s sight to listen to you rather than God.
occurrences.kjv: But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge ye.

occurrences.bsb: “Tell me,” said Peter, “is this the price you and your husband got for the land?” “Yes,” she answered, “that is the price.”
occurrences.kjv: And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether ye sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much.

occurrences.bsb: But if it is from God, you will not be able to stop them. You may even find yourselves fighting against God.”
occurrences.kjv: But if it be of God, ye cannot overthrow it; lest haply ye be found even to fight against God.

occurrences.bsb: Then the high priest asked Stephen, “Are these charges true?”
occurrences.kjv: Then said the high priest, Are these things so?

occurrences.bsb: Repent, therefore, of your wickedness, and pray to the Lord. Perhaps He will forgive you for the intent of your heart.
occurrences.kjv: Repent therefore of this thy wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of thine heart may be forgiven thee.

occurrences.bsb: They called out to ask if Simon called Peter was staying there.
occurrences.kjv: And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there.

occurrences.bsb: So if God gave them the same gift He gave us who believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I to hinder the work of God?”
occurrences.kjv: Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God?

occurrences.bsb: Meanwhile those scattered by the persecution that began with Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the message only to Jews.
occurrences.kjv: Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word to none but unto the Jews only.

occurrences.bsb: After the reading from the Law and the Prophets, the synagogue leaders sent word to them: “Brothers, if you have a word of encouragement for the people, please speak.”
occurrences.kjv: And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, Ye men and brethren, if ye have any word of exhortation for the people, say on.

occurrences.bsb: And when she and her household had been baptized, she urged us, “If you consider me a believer in the Lord, come and stay at my house.” And she persuaded us.
occurrences.kjv: And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If ye have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us.

occurrences.bsb: Now the Bereans were more noble-minded than the Thessalonians, for they received the message with great eagerness and examined the Scriptures every day to see if these teachings were true.
occurrences.kjv: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.

occurrences.bsb: God intended that they would seek Him and perhaps reach out for Him and find Him, though He is not far from each one of us.
occurrences.kjv: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:

occurrences.bsb: But just as Paul was about to speak, Gallio told the Jews, “If this matter involved a wrongdoing or vicious crime, O Jews, it would be reasonable for me to hear your complaint.
occurrences.kjv: And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O ye Jews, reason would that I should bear with you:

occurrences.bsb: But since it is a dispute about words and names and your own law, settle it yourselves. I refuse to be a judge of such things.”
occurrences.kjv: But if it be a question of words and names, and of your law, look ye to it; for I will be no judge of such matters.

occurrences.bsb: and asked them, “Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you became believers?” “No,” they answered, “we have not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”
occurrences.kjv: He said unto them, Have ye received the Holy Ghost since ye believed? And they said unto him, We have not so much as heard whether there be any Holy Ghost.

occurrences.bsb: So if Demetrius and his fellow craftsmen have a complaint against anyone, the courts are open and proconsuls are available. Let them bring charges against one another there.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore if Demetrius, and the craftsmen which are with him, have a matter against any man, the law is open, and there are deputies: let them implead one another.

occurrences.bsb: But if you are seeking anything beyond this, it must be settled in a legal assembly.
occurrences.kjv: But if ye enquire any thing concerning other matters, it shall be determined in a lawful assembly.

occurrences.bsb: Paul had decided to sail past Ephesus to avoid spending time in the province of Asia, because he was in a hurry to reach Jerusalem, if possible, by the day of Pentecost.
occurrences.kjv: For Paul had determined to sail by Ephesus, because he would not spend the time in Asia: for he hasted, if it were possible for him, to be at Jerusalem the day of Pentecost.

occurrences.bsb: As they were about to take Paul into the barracks, he asked the commander, “May I say something to you?” “Do you speak Greek?” he replied.
occurrences.kjv: And as Paul was to be led into the castle, he said unto the chief captain, May I speak unto thee? Who said, Canst thou speak Greek?

occurrences.bsb: But as they stretched him out to strap him down, Paul said to the centurion standing there, “Is it lawful for you to flog a Roman citizen without a trial?”
occurrences.kjv: And as they bound him with thongs, Paul said unto the centurion that stood by, Is it lawful for you to scourge a man that is a Roman, and uncondemned?

occurrences.bsb: A great clamor arose, and some scribes from the party of the Pharisees got up and contended sharply, “We find nothing wrong with this man. What if a spirit or an angel has spoken to him?”
occurrences.kjv: And there arose a great cry: and the scribes that were of the Pharisees’ part arose, and strove, saying, We find no evil in this man: but if a spirit or an angel hath spoken to him, let us not fight against God.

occurrences.bsb: who ought to appear before you and bring charges, if they have anything against me.
occurrences.kjv: Who ought to have been here before thee, and object, if they had ought against me.

occurrences.bsb: So if this man has done anything wrong, let some of your leaders come down with me and accuse him there.”
occurrences.kjv: Let them therefore, said he, which among you are able, go down with me, and accuse this man, if there be any wickedness in him.

occurrences.bsb: If, however, I am guilty of anything worthy of death, I do not refuse to die. But if there is no truth to their accusations against me, no one has the right to hand me over to them. I appeal to Caesar!”
occurrences.kjv: For if I be an offender, or have committed any thing worthy of death, I refuse not to die: but if there be none of these things whereof these accuse me, no man may deliver me unto them. I appeal unto Cesar.

occurrences.bsb: Since I was at a loss as to how to investigate these matters, I asked if he was willing to go to Jerusalem and be tried there on these charges.
occurrences.kjv: And because I doubted of such manner of questions, I asked him whether he would go to Jerusalem, and there be judged of these matters.

occurrences.bsb: Why would any of you consider it incredible that God raises the dead?
occurrences.kjv: Why should it be thought a thing incredible with you, that God should raise the dead?

occurrences.bsb: that the Christ would suffer, and as the first to rise from the dead, would proclaim light to our people and to the Gentiles.”
occurrences.kjv: That Christ should suffer, and that he should be the first that should rise from the dead, and should shew light unto the people, and to the Gentiles.

occurrences.bsb: And Agrippa said to Festus, “This man could have been released if he had not appealed to Caesar.”
occurrences.kjv: Then said Agrippa unto Festus, This man might have been set at liberty, if he had not appealed unto Cesar.

occurrences.bsb: Since the harbor was unsuitable to winter in, the majority decided to sail on, hoping that somehow they could reach Phoenix to winter there. Phoenix was a harbor in Crete facing both southwest and northwest.
occurrences.kjv: And because the haven was not commodious to winter in, the more part advised to depart thence also, if by any means they might attain to Phenice, and there to winter; which is an haven of Crete, and lieth toward the south west and north west.

occurrences.bsb: When daylight came, they did not recognize the land, but they sighted a bay with a sandy beach, where they decided to run the ship aground if they could.
occurrences.kjv: And when it was day, they knew not the land: but they discovered a certain creek with a shore, into the which they were minded, if it were possible, to thrust in the ship.

occurrences.bsb: in my prayers at all times, asking that now at last by God’s will I may succeed in coming to you.
occurrences.kjv: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.

occurrences.bsb: Now you, if you call yourself a Jew; if you rely on the law and boast in God;
occurrences.kjv: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,

occurrences.bsb: What if some did not have faith? Will their lack of faith nullify God’s faithfulness?
occurrences.kjv: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?

occurrences.bsb: But if our unrighteousness highlights the righteousness of God, what shall we say? That God is unjust to inflict His wrath on us? I am speaking in human terms.
occurrences.kjv: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)

occurrences.bsb: However, if my falsehood accentuates God’s truthfulness, to the increase of His glory, why am I still condemned as a sinner?
occurrences.kjv: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?

occurrences.bsb: since there is only one God, who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through that same faith.
occurrences.kjv: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.

occurrences.bsb: If Abraham was indeed justified by works, he had something to boast about, but not before God.
occurrences.kjv: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.

occurrences.bsb: For if those who live by the law are heirs, faith is useless and the promise is worthless,
occurrences.kjv: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:

occurrences.bsb: For if, when we were enemies of God, we were reconciled to Him through the death of His Son, how much more, having been reconciled, shall we be saved through His life!
occurrences.kjv: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.

occurrences.bsb: But the gift is not like the trespass. For if the many died by the trespass of the one man, how much more did God’s grace and the gift that came by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many!
occurrences.kjv: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.

occurrences.bsb: For if, by the trespass of the one man, death reigned through that one man, how much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one man, Jesus Christ!
occurrences.kjv: For if by one man’s offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)

occurrences.bsb: For if we have been united with Him like this in His death, we will certainly also be united with Him in His resurrection.
occurrences.kjv: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:

occurrences.bsb: Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with Him.
occurrences.kjv: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:

occurrences.bsb: What then shall we say? Is the law sin? Certainly not! Indeed, I would not have been mindful of sin if not for the law. For I would not have been aware of coveting if the law had not said, “Do not covet.”
occurrences.kjv: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.

occurrences.bsb: And if I do what I do not want to do, I admit that the law is good.
occurrences.kjv: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.

occurrences.bsb: And if I do what I do not want, it is no longer I who do it, but it is sin living in me that does it.
occurrences.kjv: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

occurrences.bsb: You, however, are controlled not by the flesh, but by the Spirit, if the Spirit of God lives in you. And if anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, he does not belong to Christ.
occurrences.kjv: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.

occurrences.bsb: But if Christ is in you, your body is dead because of sin, yet your spirit is alive because of righteousness.
occurrences.kjv: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

occurrences.bsb: And if the Spirit of Him who raised Jesus from the dead is living in you, He who raised Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through His Spirit, who lives in you.
occurrences.kjv: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.

occurrences.bsb: For if you live according to the flesh, you will die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.
occurrences.kjv: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.

occurrences.bsb: And if we are children, then we are heirs: heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ—if indeed we suffer with Him, so that we may also be glorified with Him.
occurrences.kjv: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

occurrences.bsb: But if we hope for what we do not yet see, we wait for it patiently.
occurrences.kjv: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.

occurrences.bsb: What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
occurrences.kjv: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

occurrences.bsb: What if God, intending to show His wrath and make His power known, bore with great patience the vessels of His wrath, prepared for destruction?
occurrences.kjv: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:

occurrences.bsb: It is just as Isaiah foretold: “Unless the Lord of Hosts had left us descendants, we would have become like Sodom, we would have resembled Gomorrah.”
occurrences.kjv: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.

occurrences.bsb: And if it is by grace, then it is no longer by works. Otherwise, grace would no longer be grace.
occurrences.kjv: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.

occurrences.bsb: But if their trespass means riches for the world, and their failure means riches for the Gentiles, how much greater riches will their fullness bring!
occurrences.kjv: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?

occurrences.bsb: in the hope that I may provoke my own people to jealousy and save some of them.
occurrences.kjv: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.

occurrences.bsb: For if their rejection is the reconciliation of the world, what will their acceptance be but life from the dead?
occurrences.kjv: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?

occurrences.bsb: If the first part of the dough is holy, so is the whole batch; if the root is holy, so are the branches.
occurrences.kjv: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.

occurrences.bsb: Now if some branches have been broken off, and you, a wild olive shoot, have been grafted in among the others to share in the nourishment of the olive root,
occurrences.kjv: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;

occurrences.bsb: do not boast over those branches. If you do, remember this: You do not support the root, but the root supports you.
occurrences.kjv: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.

occurrences.bsb: For if God did not spare the natural branches, He will certainly not spare you either.
occurrences.kjv: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.

occurrences.bsb: For if you were cut from a wild olive tree, and contrary to nature were grafted into one that is cultivated, how much more readily will these, the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree!
occurrences.kjv: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?

occurrences.bsb: If it is possible on your part, live at peace with everyone.
occurrences.kjv: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

occurrences.bsb: Everyone must submit himself to the governing authorities, for there is no authority except that which is from God. The authorities that exist have been appointed by God.
occurrences.kjv: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.

occurrences.bsb: Be indebted to no one, except to one another in love. For he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
occurrences.kjv: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.

occurrences.bsb: The commandments “Do not commit adultery,” “Do not murder,” “Do not steal,” “Do not covet,” and any other commandments, are summed up in this one decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
occurrences.kjv: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

occurrences.bsb: I am convinced and fully persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself. But if anyone regards something as unclean, then for him it is unclean.
occurrences.kjv: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

occurrences.bsb: If your brother is distressed by what you eat, you are no longer acting in love. Do not by your eating destroy your brother, for whom Christ died.
occurrences.kjv: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.

occurrences.bsb: They were pleased to do it, and indeed they owe it to them. For if the Gentiles have shared in their spiritual blessings, they are obligated to minister to them with material blessings.
occurrences.kjv: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.

occurrences.bsb: I thank God that I did not baptize any of you except Crispus and Gaius,
occurrences.kjv: I thank God that I baptized none of you, but Crispus and Gaius;

occurrences.bsb: Yes, I also baptized the household of Stephanas; beyond that I do not remember if I baptized anyone else.
occurrences.kjv: And I baptized also the household of Stephanas: besides, I know not whether I baptized any other.

occurrences.bsb: For I resolved to know nothing while I was with you except Jesus Christ and Him crucified.
occurrences.kjv: For I determined not to know any thing among you, save Jesus Christ, and him crucified.
