occurrences.bsb: None of the rulers of this age understood it. For if they had, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
occurrences.kjv: Which none of the princes of this world knew: for had they known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.

occurrences.bsb: For who among men knows the thoughts of man except his own spirit within him? So too, no one knows the thoughts of God except the Spirit of God.
occurrences.kjv: For what man knoweth the things of a man, save the spirit of man which is in him? even so the things of God knoweth no man, but the Spirit of God.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone builds on this foundation using gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, or straw,
occurrences.kjv: Now if any man build upon this foundation gold, silver, precious stones, wood, hay, stubble;

occurrences.bsb: If what he has built survives, he will receive a reward.
occurrences.kjv: If any man’s work abide which he hath built thereupon, he shall receive a reward.

occurrences.bsb: If it is burned up, he will suffer loss. He himself will be saved, but only as if through the flames.
occurrences.kjv: If any man’s work shall be burned, he shall suffer loss: but he himself shall be saved; yet so as by fire.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, and you are that temple.
occurrences.kjv: If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are.

occurrences.bsb: Let no one deceive himself. If any of you thinks he is wise in this age, he should become a fool, so that he may become wise.
occurrences.kjv: Let no man deceive himself. If any man among you seemeth to be wise in this world, let him become a fool, that he may be wise.

occurrences.bsb: For who makes you so superior? What do you have that you did not receive? And if you did receive it, why do you boast as though you did not?
occurrences.kjv: For who maketh thee to differ from another? and what hast thou that thou didst not receive? now if thou didst receive it, why dost thou glory, as if thou hadst not received it?

occurrences.bsb: Do you not know that the saints will judge the world? And if you are to judge the world, are you not competent to judge trivial cases?
occurrences.kjv: Do ye not know that the saints shall judge the world? and if the world shall be judged by you, are ye unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

occurrences.bsb: Do not deprive each other, except by mutual consent and for a time, so you may devote yourselves to prayer. Then come together again, so that Satan will not tempt you through your lack of self-control.
occurrences.kjv: Defraud ye not one the other, except it be with consent for a time, that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.

occurrences.bsb: But if they cannot control themselves, let them marry. For it is better to marry than to burn with passion.
occurrences.kjv: But if they cannot contain, let them marry: for it is better to marry than to burn.

occurrences.bsb: To the rest I say this (I, not the Lord): If a brother has an unbelieving wife and she is willing to live with him, he must not divorce her.
occurrences.kjv: But to the rest speak I, not the Lord: If any brother hath a wife that believeth not, and she be pleased to dwell with him, let him not put her away.

occurrences.bsb: And if a woman has an unbelieving husband and he is willing to live with her, she must not divorce him.
occurrences.kjv: And the woman which hath an husband that believeth not, and if he be pleased to dwell with her, let her not leave him.

occurrences.bsb: But if the unbeliever leaves, let him go. The believing brother or sister is not bound in such cases. God has called you to live in peace.
occurrences.kjv: But if the unbelieving depart, let him depart. A brother or a sister is not under bondage in such cases: but God hath called us to peace.

occurrences.bsb: How do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?
occurrences.kjv: For what knowest thou, O wife, whether thou shalt save thy husband? or how knowest thou, O man, whether thou shalt save thy wife?

occurrences.bsb: Regardless, each one should lead the life that the Lord has assigned to him and to which God has called him. This is what I prescribe in all the churches.
occurrences.kjv: But as God hath distributed to every man, as the Lord hath called every one, so let him walk. And so ordain I in all churches.

occurrences.bsb: Were you a slave when you were called? Do not let it concern you—but if you can gain your freedom, take the opportunity.
occurrences.kjv: Art thou called being a servant? care not for it: but if thou mayest be made free, use it rather.

occurrences.bsb: However, if someone thinks he is acting inappropriately toward his betrothed, and if she is beyond her youth and they ought to marry, let him do as he wishes; he is not sinning; they should get married.
occurrences.kjv: But if any man think that he behaveth himself uncomely toward his virgin, if she pass the flower of her age, and need so require, let him do what he will, he sinneth not: let them marry.

occurrences.bsb: The one who thinks he knows something does not yet know as he ought to know.
occurrences.kjv: And if any man think that he knoweth any thing, he knoweth nothing yet as he ought to know.

occurrences.bsb: But the one who loves God is known by God.
occurrences.kjv: But if any man love God, the same is known of him.

occurrences.bsb: So about eating food sacrificed to idols: We know that an idol is nothing at all in the world, and that there is no God but one.
occurrences.kjv: As concerning therefore the eating of those things that are offered in sacrifice unto idols, we know that an idol is nothing in the world, and that there is none other God but one.

occurrences.bsb: For even if there are so-called gods, whether in heaven or on earth (as there are many so-called gods and lords),
occurrences.kjv: For though there be that are called gods, whether in heaven or in earth, (as there be gods many, and lords many,)

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, if what I eat causes my brother to stumble, I will never eat meat again, so that I will not cause him to stumble.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore, if meat make my brother to offend, I will eat no flesh while the world standeth, lest I make my brother to offend.

occurrences.bsb: Even if I am not an apostle to others, surely I am to you. For you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.
occurrences.kjv: If I be not an apostle unto others, yet doubtless I am to you: for the seal of mine apostleship are ye in the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: If we have sown spiritual seed among you, is it too much for us to reap a material harvest from you?
occurrences.kjv: If we have sown unto you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we shall reap your carnal things?

occurrences.bsb: If others have this right to your support, shouldn’t we have it all the more? But we did not exercise this right. Instead, we put up with anything rather than hinder the gospel of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: If others be partakers of this power over you, are not we rather? Nevertheless we have not used this power; but suffer all things, lest we should hinder the gospel of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: If my preaching is voluntary, I have a reward. But if it is not voluntary, I am still entrusted with a responsibility.
occurrences.kjv: For if I do this thing willingly, I have a reward: but if against my will, a dispensation of the gospel is committed unto me.

occurrences.bsb: No temptation has seized you except what is common to man. And God is faithful; He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, He will also provide an escape, so that you can stand up under it.
occurrences.kjv: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.

occurrences.bsb: If an unbeliever invites you to a meal and you want to go, eat anything set before you without raising questions of conscience.
occurrences.kjv: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.

occurrences.bsb: If I partake in the meal with thankfulness, why am I denounced because of that for which I give thanks?
occurrences.kjv: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?

occurrences.bsb: If a woman does not cover her head, she should have her hair cut off. And if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut or shaved off, she should cover her head.
occurrences.kjv: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone is inclined to dispute this, we have no other practice, nor do the churches of God.
occurrences.kjv: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.

occurrences.bsb: Now if we judged ourselves properly, we would not come under judgment.
occurrences.kjv: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone is hungry, he should eat at home, so that when you come together it will not result in judgment. And when I come, I will give instructions about the remaining matters.
occurrences.kjv: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore I inform you that no one who is speaking by the Spirit of God says, “Jesus be cursed,” and no one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” except by the Holy Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.

occurrences.bsb: If the whole body were an eye, where would the sense of hearing be? If the whole body were an ear, where would the sense of smell be?
occurrences.kjv: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?

occurrences.bsb: If they were all one part, where would the body be?
occurrences.kjv: And if they were all one member, where were the body?

occurrences.bsb: I wish that all of you could speak in tongues, but I would rather have you prophesy. He who prophesies is greater than one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets so that the church may be edified.
occurrences.kjv: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.

occurrences.bsb: Assuredly, there are many different languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.
occurrences.kjv: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.

occurrences.bsb: If they wish to inquire about something, they are to ask their own husbands at home; for it is dishonorable for a woman to speak in the church.
occurrences.kjv: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone considers himself a prophet or spiritual person, let him acknowledge that what I am writing you is the Lord’s command.
occurrences.kjv: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.

occurrences.bsb: But if anyone ignores this, he himself will be ignored.
occurrences.kjv: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.

occurrences.bsb: By this gospel you are saved, if you hold firmly to the word I preached to you. Otherwise, you have believed in vain.
occurrences.kjv: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.

occurrences.bsb: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
occurrences.kjv: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?

occurrences.bsb: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.
occurrences.kjv: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:

occurrences.bsb: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is worthless, and so is your faith.
occurrences.kjv: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.

occurrences.bsb: In that case, we are also exposed as false witnesses about God. For we have testified about God that He raised Christ from the dead, but He did not raise Him if in fact the dead are not raised.
occurrences.kjv: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.

occurrences.bsb: For if the dead are not raised, then not even Christ has been raised.
occurrences.kjv: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:

occurrences.bsb: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.
occurrences.kjv: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.

occurrences.bsb: If our hope in Christ is for this life alone, we are to be pitied more than all men.
occurrences.kjv: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.

occurrences.bsb: If these things are not so, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for them?
occurrences.kjv: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?

occurrences.bsb: If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus for human motives, what did I gain? If the dead are not raised, “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
occurrences.kjv: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.

occurrences.bsb: And what you sow is not the body that will be, but just a seed, perhaps of wheat or something else.
occurrences.kjv: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:

occurrences.bsb: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.
occurrences.kjv: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone does not love the Lord, let him be under a curse. Come, O Lord!
occurrences.kjv: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maran-atha.

occurrences.bsb: For if I grieve you, who is left to cheer me but those whom I have grieved?
occurrences.kjv: For if I make you sorry, who is he then that maketh me glad, but the same which is made sorry by me?

occurrences.bsb: Now if anyone has caused grief, he has not grieved me but all of you—to some degree, not to overstate it.
occurrences.kjv: But if any have caused grief, he hath not grieved me, but in part: that I may not overcharge you all.

occurrences.bsb: My purpose in writing you was to see if you would stand the test and be obedient in everything.
occurrences.kjv: For to this end also did I write, that I might know the proof of you, whether ye be obedient in all things.

occurrences.bsb: If you forgive anyone, I also forgive him. And if I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven it in the presence of Christ for your sake,
occurrences.kjv: To whom ye forgive any thing, I forgive also: for if I forgave any thing, to whom I forgave it, for your sakes forgave I it in the person of Christ;

occurrences.bsb: Now if the ministry of death, which was engraved in letters on stone, came with such glory that the Israelites could not gaze at the face of Moses because of its fleeting glory,
occurrences.kjv: But if the ministration of death, written and engraven in stones, was glorious, so that the children of Israel could not stedfastly behold the face of Moses for the glory of his countenance; which glory was to be done away:

occurrences.bsb: For if the ministry of condemnation was glorious, how much more glorious is the ministry of righteousness!
occurrences.kjv: For if the ministration of condemnation be glory, much more doth the ministration of righteousness exceed in glory.

occurrences.bsb: For if what was fading away came with glory, how much greater is the glory of that which endures!
occurrences.kjv: For if that which is done away was glorious, much more that which remaineth is glorious.

occurrences.bsb: And even if our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing.
occurrences.kjv: But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost:

occurrences.bsb: Therefore we do not lose heart. Though our outer self is wasting away, yet our inner self is being renewed day by day.
occurrences.kjv: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.

occurrences.bsb: because when we are clothed, we will not be found naked.
occurrences.kjv: If so be that being clothed we shall not be found naked.

occurrences.bsb: So from now on we regard no one according to the flesh. Although we once regarded Christ in this way, we do so no longer.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore henceforth know we no man after the flesh: yea, though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now henceforth know we him no more.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away. Behold, the new has come!
occurrences.kjv: Therefore if any man be in Christ, he is a new creature: old things are passed away; behold, all things are become new.

occurrences.bsb: Even if I caused you sorrow by my letter, I do not regret it. Although I did regret it—for I see that my letter caused you sorrow, but only for a short time—
occurrences.kjv: For though I made you sorry with a letter, I do not repent, though I did repent: for I perceive that the same epistle hath made you sorry, though it were but for a season.

occurrences.bsb: So even though I wrote to you, it was not on account of the one who did wrong or the one who was harmed, but rather that your earnestness on our behalf would be made clear to you in the sight of God.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore, though I wrote unto you, I did it not for his cause that had done the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered wrong, but that our care for you in the sight of God might appear unto you.

occurrences.bsb: Indeed, I was not embarrassed by anything I had boasted to him about you. But just as everything we said to you was true, so our boasting to Titus has proved to be true as well.
occurrences.kjv: For if I have boasted any thing to him of you, I am not ashamed; but as we spake all things to you in truth, even so our boasting, which I made before Titus, is found a truth.

occurrences.bsb: For if the eagerness is there, the gift is acceptable according to what one has, not according to what he does not have.
occurrences.kjv: For if there be first a willing mind, it is accepted according to that a man hath, and not according to that he hath not.

occurrences.bsb: You are looking at outward appearances. If anyone is confident that he belongs to Christ, he should remind himself that we belong to Christ just as much as he does.
occurrences.kjv: Do ye look on things after the outward appearance? If any man trust to himself that he is Christ’s, let him of himself think this again, that, as he is Christ’s, even so are we Christ’s.

occurrences.bsb: For if someone comes and proclaims a Jesus other than the One we proclaimed, or if you receive a different spirit than the One you received, or a different gospel than the one you accepted, you put up with it very easily.
occurrences.kjv: For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached, or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted, ye might well bear with him.

occurrences.bsb: Although I am not a polished speaker, I am certainly not lacking in knowledge. We have made this clear to you in every way possible.
occurrences.kjv: But though I be rude in speech, yet not in knowledge; but we have been throughly made manifest among you in all things.

occurrences.bsb: It is not surprising, then, if his servants masquerade as servants of righteousness. Their end will correspond to their actions.
occurrences.kjv: Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness; whose end shall be according to their works.

occurrences.bsb: I repeat: Let no one take me for a fool. But if you do, then receive me as a fool, so that I too may boast a little.
occurrences.kjv: I say again, Let no man think me a fool; if otherwise, yet as a fool receive me, that I may boast myself a little.

occurrences.bsb: In fact, you even put up with anyone who enslaves you or exploits you or takes advantage of you or exalts himself or strikes you in the face.
occurrences.kjv: For ye suffer, if a man bring you into bondage, if a man devour you, if a man take of you, if a man exalt himself, if a man smite you on the face.

occurrences.bsb: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that show my weakness.
occurrences.kjv: If I must needs glory, I will glory of the things which concern mine infirmities.

occurrences.bsb: I will boast about such a man, but I will not boast about myself, except in my weaknesses.
occurrences.kjv: Of such an one will I glory: yet of myself I will not glory, but in mine infirmities.

occurrences.bsb: I have become a fool, but you drove me to it. In fact, you should have commended me, since I am in no way inferior to those “super-apostles,” even though I am nothing.
occurrences.kjv: I am become a fool in glorying; ye have compelled me: for I ought to have been commended of you: for in nothing am I behind the very chiefest apostles, though I be nothing.

occurrences.bsb: In what way were you inferior to the other churches, except that I was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!
occurrences.kjv: For what is it wherein ye were inferior to other churches, except it be that I myself was not burdensome to you? forgive me this wrong.

occurrences.bsb: And for the sake of your souls, I will most gladly spend my money and myself. If I love you more, will you love me less?
occurrences.kjv: And I will very gladly spend and be spent for you; though the more abundantly I love you, the less I be loved.

occurrences.bsb: Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves. Do you not realize that Jesus Christ is in you—unless you fail the test?
occurrences.kjv: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?

occurrences.bsb: which is not even a gospel. Evidently some people are troubling you and trying to distort the gospel of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: Which is not another; but there be some that trouble you, and would pervert the gospel of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: As we have said before, so now I say again: If anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to the one you received, let him be under a curse!
occurrences.kjv: As we said before, so say I now again, If any man preach any other gospel unto you than that ye have received, let him be accursed.

occurrences.bsb: Am I now seeking the approval of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? If I were still trying to please men, I would not be a servant of Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For do I now persuade men, or God? or do I seek to please men? for if I yet pleased men, I should not be the servant of Christ.

occurrences.bsb: But I saw none of the other apostles except James, the Lord’s brother.
occurrences.kjv: But other of the apostles saw I none, save James the Lord’s brother.

occurrences.bsb: When I saw that they were not walking in line with the truth of the gospel, I said to Cephas in front of them all, “If you, who are a Jew, live like a Gentile and not like a Jew, how can you compel the Gentiles to live like Jews?”
occurrences.kjv: But when I saw that they walked not uprightly according to the truth of the gospel, I said unto Peter before them all, If thou, being a Jew, livest after the manner of Gentiles, and not as do the Jews, why compellest thou the Gentiles to live as do the Jews?

occurrences.bsb: But if, while we seek to be justified in Christ, we ourselves are found to be sinners, does that make Christ a minister of sin? Certainly not!
occurrences.kjv: But if, while we seek to be justified by Christ, we ourselves also are found sinners, is therefore Christ the minister of sin? God forbid.

occurrences.bsb: If I rebuild what I have already torn down, I prove myself to be a lawbreaker.
occurrences.kjv: For if I build again the things which I destroyed, I make myself a transgressor.

occurrences.bsb: I do not set aside the grace of God. For if righteousness comes through the law, then Christ died for nothing.
occurrences.kjv: I do not frustrate the grace of God: for if righteousness come by the law, then Christ is dead in vain.

occurrences.bsb: Have you suffered so much for nothing, if it really was for nothing?
occurrences.kjv: Have ye suffered so many things in vain? if it be yet in vain.

occurrences.bsb: For if the inheritance depends on the law, then it no longer depends on a promise; but God freely granted it to Abraham through a promise.
occurrences.kjv: For if the inheritance be of the law, it is no more of promise: but God gave it to Abraham by promise.

occurrences.bsb: Is the law, then, opposed to the promises of God? Certainly not! For if a law had been given that could impart life, then righteousness would certainly have come from the law.
occurrences.kjv: Is the law then against the promises of God? God forbid: for if there had been a law given which could have given life, verily righteousness should have been by the law.

occurrences.bsb: And if you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham’s seed and heirs according to the promise.
occurrences.kjv: And if ye be Christ’s, then are ye Abraham’s seed, and heirs according to the promise.

occurrences.bsb: So you are no longer a slave, but a son; and since you are a son, you are also an heir through God.
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

occurrences.bsb: What then has become of your blessing? For I can testify that, if it were possible, you would have torn out your eyes and given them to me.
occurrences.kjv: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.

occurrences.bsb: Now, brothers, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still being persecuted? In that case the offense of the cross has been abolished.
occurrences.kjv: And I, brethren, if I yet preach circumcision, why do I yet suffer persecution? then is the offence of the cross ceased.

occurrences.bsb: But if you keep on biting and devouring one another, watch out, or you will be consumed by one another.
occurrences.kjv: But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another.

occurrences.bsb: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
occurrences.kjv: But if ye be led of the Spirit, ye are not under the law.

occurrences.bsb: Since we live by the Spirit, let us walk in step with the Spirit.
occurrences.kjv: If we live in the Spirit, let us also walk in the Spirit.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
occurrences.kjv: For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceiveth himself.

occurrences.bsb: But as for me, may I never boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.
occurrences.kjv: But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world.

occurrences.bsb: Surely you have heard about the stewardship of God’s grace that was given to me for you,
occurrences.kjv: If ye have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me to you-ward:

occurrences.bsb: What does “He ascended” mean, except that He also descended to the lower parts of the earth?
occurrences.kjv: (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth?

occurrences.bsb: Surely you heard of Him and were taught in Him—in keeping with the truth that is in Jesus—
occurrences.kjv: If so be that ye have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus:

occurrences.bsb: Let no unwholesome talk come out of your mouths, but only what is helpful for building up the one in need and bringing grace to those who listen.
occurrences.kjv: Let no corrupt communication proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers.

occurrences.bsb: But if I go on living in the body, this will mean fruitful labor for me. So what shall I choose? I do not know.
occurrences.kjv: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore if you have any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort from His love, if any fellowship with the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,
occurrences.kjv: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,

occurrences.bsb: But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you.
occurrences.kjv: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.

occurrences.bsb: though I myself could have such confidence. If anyone else thinks he has grounds for confidence in the flesh, I have more:
occurrences.kjv: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:

occurrences.bsb: and so, somehow, to attain to the resurrection from the dead.
occurrences.kjv: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.

occurrences.bsb: Not that I have already obtained all this, or have already been made perfect, but I press on to take hold of that for which Christ Jesus took hold of me.
occurrences.kjv: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.

occurrences.bsb: All of us who are mature should embrace this point of view. And if you think differently about some issue, God will reveal this to you as well.
occurrences.kjv: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.

occurrences.bsb: Finally, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable—if anything is excellent or praiseworthy—think on these things.
occurrences.kjv: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.

occurrences.bsb: And as you Philippians know, in the early days of the gospel, when I left Macedonia, no church but you partnered with me in the matter of giving and receiving.
occurrences.kjv: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.

occurrences.bsb: if indeed you continue in your faith, established and firm, not moved from the hope of the gospel you heard, which has been proclaimed to every creature under heaven, and of which I, Paul, have become a servant.
occurrences.kjv: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;

occurrences.bsb: For although I am absent from you in body, I am present with you in spirit, and I delight to see your orderly condition and firm faith in Christ.
occurrences.kjv: For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, joying and beholding your order, and the stedfastness of your faith in Christ.

occurrences.bsb: If you have died with Christ to the spiritual forces of the world, why, as though you still belonged to the world, do you submit to its regulations:
occurrences.kjv: Wherefore if ye be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are ye subject to ordinances,

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, since you have been raised with Christ, strive for the things above, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
occurrences.kjv: If ye then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sitteth on the right hand of God.

occurrences.bsb: For since we believe that Jesus died and rose again, we also believe that God will bring with Jesus those who have fallen asleep in Him.
occurrences.kjv: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so them also which sleep in Jesus will God bring with him.

occurrences.bsb: After all, it is only right for God to repay with affliction those who afflict you,
occurrences.kjv: Seeing it is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you;

occurrences.bsb: For even while we were with you, we gave you this command: “If anyone is unwilling to work, he shall not eat.”
occurrences.kjv: For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.

occurrences.bsb: Take note of anyone who does not obey the instructions we have given in this letter. Do not associate with him, so that he may be ashamed.
occurrences.kjv: And if any man obey not our word by this epistle, note that man, and have no company with him, that he may be ashamed.

occurrences.bsb: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave traders and liars and perjurers, and for anyone else who is averse to sound teaching
occurrences.kjv: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;

occurrences.bsb: This is a trustworthy saying: If anyone aspires to be an overseer, he desires a noble task.
occurrences.kjv: This is a true saying, If a man desire the office of a bishop, he desireth a good work.

occurrences.bsb: For if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how can he care for the church of God?
occurrences.kjv: (For if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God?)

occurrences.bsb: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, they must first learn to show godliness to their own family and repay their parents, for this is pleasing in the sight of God.
occurrences.kjv: But if any widow have children or nephews, let them learn first to shew piety at home, and to requite their parents: for that is good and acceptable before God.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone does not provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
occurrences.kjv: But if any provide not for his own, and specially for those of his own house, he hath denied the faith, and is worse than an infidel.

occurrences.bsb: and well known for good deeds such as bringing up children, entertaining strangers, washing the feet of the saints, imparting relief to the afflicted, and devoting herself to every good work.
occurrences.kjv: Well reported of for good works; if she have brought up children, if she have lodged strangers, if she have washed the saints’ feet, if she have relieved the afflicted, if she have diligently followed every good work.

occurrences.bsb: If any believing woman has dependent widows, she must assist them and not allow the church to be burdened, so that it can help the widows who are truly in need.
occurrences.kjv: If any man or woman that believeth have widows, let them relieve them, and let not the church be charged; that it may relieve them that are widows indeed.

occurrences.bsb: Do not entertain an accusation against an elder, except on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
occurrences.kjv: Against an elder receive not an accusation, but before two or three witnesses.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone teaches another doctrine and disagrees with the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and with godly teaching,
occurrences.kjv: If any man teach otherwise, and consent not to wholesome words, even the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness;

occurrences.bsb: This is a trustworthy saying: If we died with Him, we will also live with Him;
occurrences.kjv: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:

occurrences.bsb: if we endure, we will also reign with Him; if we deny Him, He will also deny us;
occurrences.kjv: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:

occurrences.bsb: if we are faithless, He remains faithful, for He cannot deny Himself.
occurrences.kjv: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.

occurrences.bsb: An elder must be blameless, the husband of but one wife, having children who are believers and who are not open to accusation of indiscretion or insubordination.
occurrences.kjv: If any be blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.

occurrences.bsb: So if you consider me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.
occurrences.kjv: If thou count me therefore a partner, receive him as myself.

occurrences.bsb: But if he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything, charge it to my account.
occurrences.kjv: If he hath wronged thee, or oweth thee ought, put that on mine account;

occurrences.bsb: For if the message spoken by angels was binding, and every transgression and disobedience received its just punishment,
occurrences.kjv: For if the word spoken by angels was stedfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompence of reward;

occurrences.bsb: So I swore on oath in My anger, ‘They shall never enter My rest.’”
occurrences.kjv: So I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.)

occurrences.bsb: And to whom did He swear that they would never enter His rest? Was it not to those who disobeyed?
occurrences.kjv: And to whom sware he that they should not enter into his rest, but to them that believed not?

occurrences.bsb: Now we who have believed enter that rest. As for the others, it is just as God has said: “So I swore on oath in My anger, ‘They shall never enter My rest.’” And yet His works have been finished since the foundation of the world.
occurrences.kjv: For we which have believed do enter into rest, as he said, As I have sworn in my wrath, if they shall enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

occurrences.bsb: And again, as He says in the passage above: “They shall never enter My rest.”
occurrences.kjv: And in this place again, If they shall enter into my rest.

occurrences.bsb: For if Joshua had given them rest, God would not have spoken later about another day.
occurrences.kjv: For if Jesus had given them rest, then would he not afterward have spoken of another day.

occurrences.bsb: Even though we speak like this, beloved, we are convinced of better things in your case—things that accompany salvation.
occurrences.kjv: But, beloved, we are persuaded better things of you, and things that accompany salvation, though we thus speak.

occurrences.bsb: saying, “I will surely bless you and multiply your descendants.”
occurrences.kjv: Saying, Surely blessing I will bless thee, and multiplying I will multiply thee.

occurrences.bsb: Now if perfection could have been attained through the Levitical priesthood (for on this basis the people received the law), why was there still need for another priest to appear—one in the order of Melchizedek and not in the order of Aaron?
occurrences.kjv: If therefore perfection were by the Levitical priesthood, (for under it the people received the law,) what further need was there that another priest should rise after the order of Melchisedec, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

occurrences.bsb: And this point is even more clear if another priest like Melchizedek appears,
occurrences.kjv: And it is yet far more evident: for that after the similitude of Melchisedec there ariseth another priest,

occurrences.bsb: Now if He were on earth, He would not be a priest, since there are already priests who offer gifts according to the law.
occurrences.kjv: For if he were on earth, he should not be a priest, seeing that there are priests that offer gifts according to the law:

occurrences.bsb: For if that first covenant had been without fault, no place would have been sought for a second.
occurrences.kjv: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then should no place have been sought for the second.

occurrences.bsb: For if the blood of goats and bulls and the ashes of a heifer sprinkled on those who are ceremonially unclean sanctify them so that their bodies are clean,
occurrences.kjv: For if the blood of bulls and of goats, and the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean, sanctifieth to the purifying of the flesh:

occurrences.bsb: If they had been thinking of the country they had left, they would have had opportunity to return.
occurrences.kjv: And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out, they might have had opportunity to have returned.

occurrences.bsb: If you do not experience discipline like everyone else, then you are illegitimate children and not true sons.
occurrences.kjv: But if ye be without chastisement, whereof all are partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

occurrences.bsb: See to it that you do not refuse Him who speaks. For if the people did not escape when they refused Him who warned them on earth, how much less will we escape if we reject Him who warns us from heaven?
occurrences.kjv: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not who refused him that spake on earth, much more shall not we escape, if we turn away from him that speaketh from heaven:

occurrences.bsb: Now if any of you lacks wisdom, he should ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault, and it will be given to him.
occurrences.kjv: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally, and upbraideth not; and it shall be given him.

occurrences.bsb: For anyone who hears the word but does not carry it out is like a man who looks at his face in a mirror,
occurrences.kjv: For if any be a hearer of the word, and not a doer, he is like unto a man beholding his natural face in a glass:

occurrences.bsb: If anyone considers himself religious and yet does not bridle his tongue, he deceives his heart and his religion is worthless.
occurrences.kjv: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, but deceiveth his own heart, this man’s religion is vain.

occurrences.bsb: If you really fulfill the royal law stated in Scripture, “Love your neighbor as yourself,” you are doing well.
occurrences.kjv: If ye fulfil the royal law according to the scripture, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself, ye do well:

occurrences.bsb: But if you show favoritism, you sin and are convicted by the law as transgressors.
occurrences.kjv: But if ye have respect to persons, ye commit sin, and are convinced of the law as transgressors.

occurrences.bsb: For He who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not murder.” If you do not commit adultery, but do commit murder, you have become a lawbreaker.
occurrences.kjv: For he that said, Do not commit adultery, said also, Do not kill. Now if thou commit no adultery, yet if thou kill, thou art become a transgressor of the law.

occurrences.bsb: We all stumble in many ways. If anyone is never at fault in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to control his whole body.
occurrences.kjv: For in many things we offend all. If any man offend not in word, the same is a perfect man, and able also to bridle the whole body.

occurrences.bsb: When we put bits into the mouths of horses to make them obey us, we can guide the whole animal.
occurrences.kjv: Behold, we put bits in the horses’ mouths, that they may obey us; and we turn about their whole body.

occurrences.bsb: But if you harbor bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your hearts, do not boast in it or deny the truth.
occurrences.kjv: But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth.

occurrences.bsb: Brothers, do not slander one another. Anyone who speaks against his brother or judges him speaks against the law and judges it. And if you judge the law, you are not a practitioner of the law, but a judge of it.
occurrences.kjv: Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.

occurrences.bsb: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while you may have had to suffer grief in various trials
occurrences.kjv: Wherein ye greatly rejoice, though now for a season, if need be, ye are in heaviness through manifold temptations:

occurrences.bsb: Since you call on a Father who judges each one’s work impartially, conduct yourselves in reverent fear during your stay as foreigners.
occurrences.kjv: And if ye call on the Father, who without respect of persons judgeth according to every man’s work, pass the time of your sojourning here in fear:

occurrences.bsb: now that you have tasted that the Lord is good.
occurrences.kjv: If so be ye have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

occurrences.bsb: For if anyone endures the pain of unjust suffering because he is conscious of God, this is to be commended.
occurrences.kjv: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.

occurrences.bsb: How is it to your credit if you are beaten for doing wrong and you endure it? But if you suffer for doing good and you endure it, this is commendable before God.
occurrences.kjv: For what glory is it, if, when ye be buffeted for your faults, ye shall take it patiently? but if, when ye do well, and suffer for it, ye take it patiently, this is acceptable with God.

occurrences.bsb: Wives, in the same way, submit yourselves to your husbands, so that even if they refuse to believe the word, they will be won over without words by the behavior of their wives
occurrences.kjv: Likewise, ye wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; that, if any obey not the word, they also may without the word be won by the conversation of the wives;

occurrences.bsb: But even if you should suffer for what is right, you are blessed. “Do not fear what they fear; do not be shaken.”
occurrences.kjv: But and if ye suffer for righteousness’ sake, happy are ye: and be not afraid of their terror, neither be troubled;

occurrences.bsb: For it is better, if it is God’s will, to suffer for doing good than for doing evil.
occurrences.kjv: For it is better, if the will of God be so, that ye suffer for well doing, than for evil doing.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone speaks, he should speak as one conveying the words of God. If anyone serves, he should serve with the strength God provides, so that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.
occurrences.kjv: If any man speak, let him speak as the oracles of God; if any man minister, let him do it as of the ability which God giveth: that God in all things may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom be praise and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.

occurrences.bsb: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you.
occurrences.kjv: If ye be reproached for the name of Christ, happy are ye; for the spirit of glory and of God resteth upon you: on their part he is evil spoken of, but on your part he is glorified.

occurrences.bsb: But if you suffer as a Christian, do not be ashamed, but glorify God that you bear that name.
occurrences.kjv: Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.

occurrences.bsb: For it is time for judgment to begin with the family of God; and if it begins with us, what will the outcome be for those who disobey the gospel of God?
occurrences.kjv: For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God: and if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God?

occurrences.bsb: And, “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will become of the ungodly and the sinner?”
occurrences.kjv: And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?

occurrences.bsb: For if God did not spare the angels when they sinned, but cast them deep into hell, placing them in chains of darkness to be held for judgment;
occurrences.kjv: For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;

occurrences.bsb: If indeed they have escaped the corruption of the world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, only to be entangled and overcome by it again, their final condition is worse than it was at first.
occurrences.kjv: For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning.

occurrences.bsb: They went out from us, but they did not belong to us. For if they had belonged to us, they would have remained with us. But their departure made it clear that none of them belonged to us.
occurrences.kjv: They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us.

occurrences.bsb: Who is the liar, if it is not the one who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the antichrist, who denies the Father and the Son.
occurrences.kjv: Who is a liar but he that denieth that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denieth the Father and the Son.

occurrences.bsb: So do not be surprised, brothers, if the world hates you.
occurrences.kjv: Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, do not believe every spirit, but test the spirits to see whether they are from God. For many false prophets have gone out into the world.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world.

occurrences.bsb: Beloved, if God so loved us, we also ought to love one another.
occurrences.kjv: Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another.

occurrences.bsb: Who then overcomes the world? Only he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God.
occurrences.kjv: Who is he that overcometh the world, but he that believeth that Jesus is the Son of God?

occurrences.bsb: Even if we accept human testimony, the testimony of God is greater. For this is the testimony that God has given about His Son.
occurrences.kjv: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he hath testified of his Son.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone comes to you but does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your home or even greet him.
occurrences.kjv: If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed:

occurrences.bsb: Therefore, keep in mind how far you have fallen. Repent and perform the deeds you did at first. But if you do not repent, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place.
occurrences.kjv: Remember therefore from whence thou art fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.

occurrences.bsb: Therefore repent! Otherwise I will come to you shortly and wage war against them with the sword of My mouth.
occurrences.kjv: Repent; or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.

occurrences.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To the one who overcomes, I will give the hidden manna. I will also give him a white stone inscribed with a new name, known only to the one who receives it.
occurrences.kjv: He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knoweth saving he that receiveth it.

occurrences.bsb: They were told not to harm the grass of the earth or any plant or tree, but only those who did not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
occurrences.kjv: And it was commanded them that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree; but only those men which have not the seal of God in their foreheads.

occurrences.bsb: If anyone wants to harm them, fire proceeds from their mouths and devours their enemies. In this way, anyone who wants to harm them must be killed.
occurrences.kjv: And if any man will hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth, and devoureth their enemies: and if any man will hurt them, he must in this manner be killed.

occurrences.bsb: He who has an ear, let him hear:
occurrences.kjv: If any man have an ear, let him hear.

occurrences.bsb: “If anyone is destined for captivity, into captivity he will go; if anyone is to die by the sword, by the sword he must be killed.” Here is a call for the perseverance and faith of the saints.
occurrences.kjv: He that leadeth into captivity shall go into captivity: he that killeth with the sword must be killed with the sword. Here is the patience and the faith of the saints.

occurrences.bsb: so that no one could buy or sell unless he had the mark—the name of the beast or the number of its name.
occurrences.kjv: And that no man might buy or sell, save he that had the mark, or the name of the beast, or the number of his name.

occurrences.bsb: And they sang a new song before the throne and before the four living creatures and the elders. And no one could learn the song except the 144,000 who had been redeemed from the earth.
occurrences.kjv: And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand, which were redeemed from the earth.

occurrences.bsb: And a third angel followed them, calling out in a loud voice, “If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives its mark on his forehead or on his hand,
occurrences.kjv: And the third angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand,

occurrences.bsb: And the smoke of their torment rises forever and ever. Day and night there is no rest for those who worship the beast and its image, or for anyone who receives the mark of its name.”
occurrences.kjv: And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever and ever: and they have no rest day nor night, who worship the beast and his image, and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name.

occurrences.bsb: He has eyes like blazing fire, and many royal crowns on His head. He has a name written on Him that only He Himself knows.
occurrences.kjv: His eyes were as a flame of fire, and on his head were many crowns; and he had a name written, that no man knew, but he himself.

occurrences.bsb: And if anyone was found whose name was not written in the Book of Life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.
occurrences.kjv: And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.

occurrences.bsb: But nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who practices an abomination or a lie, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life.
occurrences.kjv: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb’s book of life.
